parameters.content:
## CRM · Monday pipeline report (Lesson 5.9)
Mondays 08:00, to Telegram (the full dashboard stays in HubSpot): new deals by source, value by stage, won and lost this month with reasons, the weighted forecast (each open deal's weekly_value_ngn x its stage's win chance) and the three oldest stuck deals, each with an AI one-line summary that quotes only their notes and says 'not recorded' when something is missing. The AI never changes a stage.

Credentials: HubSpot App Token credential (the "n8n Growth Desk" private app token, with only contact, company and deal read/write scopes, plus tasks if you create tasks); OpenAI; Telegram.
Placeholders: YOUR_MODEL, YOUR_TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ filterGroups: [ { filters: [ { propertyName: 'hs_is_closed', operator: 'EQ', value: 'false' } ] }, { filters: [ { propertyName: 'closedate', operator: 'GTE', value: String(new Date(new Date().getFullYear(), new Date().getMonth(), 1).getTime()) } ] }, { filters: [ { propertyName: 'createdate', operator: 'GTE', value: String(Date.now() - 7 * 864e5) } ] } ], properties: ['dealname', 'dealstage', 'weekly_value_ngn', 'createdate', 'closedate', 'hs_is_closed', 'hs_is_closed_won', 'lost_reason', 'hs_v2_date_entered_current_stage', 'hs_lastmodifieddate'], limit: 200 }) }}
={{ JSON.stringify({ properties: ['lead_source'], inputs: [ ...new Set(($json.results || []).flatMap(r => r.to.map(t => String(t.toObjectId)))) ].map(id => ({ id })) }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ filterGroups: [ { filters: [ { propertyName: 'associations.deal', operator: 'EQ', value: $json.deal_id } ] } ], properties: ['hs_note_body', 'hs_timestamp'], sorts: [ { propertyName: 'hs_timestamp', direction: 'DESCENDING' } ], limit: 10 }) }}

messageValues.message: Summarise this deal in one line: where we are, what they want, next step. Use only what the notes say, quoting short phrases. Write 'not recorded' for anything missing. Never suggest changing the stage yourself.
